name: Winches and hoists
summary: Drums and chain blocks that pull or lift heavy loads: vehicle winches, hand winches, come-alongs and hoists.
identify: Vehicle winches sit on 4x4 bumpers with a 12V motor and drum. Boat trailers have hand-crank winches; workshops and farms have chain hoists and ratchet come-alongs. Capacity is stamped on the body.
test: Run it in and out unloaded: the drum should turn smoothly and the brake should hold. Reject cable with kinks or broken strands, and under load keep clear of the line: a snapping cable whips with deadly force.

decay.note: The mechanism lasts; steel cable rusts and synthetic rope weakens in sunlight.
